levels.1: Use the game's only official release.
levels.2: Run an owned 3DS copy on hardware or a compatible 3DS emulator.
levels.3: Use the original Nintendo 3DS release. If emulating a lawful dump, enlarge the lower map screen enough to draw accurately, raise the upper screen's internal resolution independently, and record the game region plus emulator build before the first save.

levels.1: Give the hand-drawn map room to breathe.
levels.2: Keep both screens visible, with the lower map large enough to edit.
levels.3: Create a fixed two-screen layout before recording. Preserve the upper view without cropping combat information, keep every lower-screen map control readable, and test pointer alignment on a blank tile before relying on emulator scaling.

levels.1: The highest setting becomes permanent.
levels.2: Choose Risky only when creating a dedicated completion file.
levels.3: Select Risky at new-file creation and keep that save tree separate. The setting cannot be lowered, the lead character must remain active, and their defeat ends the attempt; rotate a hub save, a floor-entry save, and a pre-FOE save.

levels.1: The other settings remain flexible.
levels.2: Safety, Easy, Normal, and Hard can be changed after the file begins.
levels.3: Use the configuration menu outside battle whenever an adjustable setting needs to change. Record the setting used for each major encounter, then restore the intended archive difficulty before the next floor so the completion log remains auditable.

levels.1: Protect the current floor and the clear state.
levels.2: Reserve distinct slots for hub, floor entry, rare crafting, and clear data.
levels.3: Keep four rotating files: the latest safe hub state, the untouched entrance to the current floor, a copy before spending rare materials, and the newest clear-data record. Never overwrite the sole clear file while testing New Game Plus carryover.

levels.1: Check every inherited category before moving on.
levels.2: Load clear data and verify films, party growth, currency, and inventory.
levels.3: Start a New Cycle from duplicated clear data. Confirm the Persona Films registry, party statistics, money, and carried items at their first available menus; keep the original clear file until every inherited category matches the completed save.
